definition: The task of identifying and classifying named entities (such as people, organizations, locations, or dates) within text.
details: Entity extraction (a form of Named Entity Recognition) is a foundational NLP task used in applications ranging from information retrieval to building knowledge graphs from unstructured text.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Entity Extraction.
